text_blocks.snippet: The national animal of India is the magnificent Royal Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris).

list.snippet: Adoption Date: Officially adopted in April 1973 during the launch of Project Tiger, replacing the Asiatic lion.
Selection Reason: Chosen for its grace, strength, agility, and immense power.
Previous Status: The Asiatic lion served as the national animal until November 1972.
Conservation: Protected under Project Tiger, which works to maintain a viable population of tigers in National symbols of India.
